payload.title: Reject standalone E005 GR paths
payload.decision: Reject affine, particle-filter, and trellis E005 candidates as standalone finalists; retain the PF OOF path and ambiguity/disagreement diagnostics only as evidence for a newly pre-registered fusion experiment. Keep E004 geometry-prefix as the deployment-ready fallback. Do not build an E005 Kaggle package or submit it.
payload.rationale: PF improved aggregate pooled RMSE by 0.1411023267 versus E004 and passed controls/diversity/worst-tail gates, but failed both p90 gates, the 4-of-5 repeated-map gate, spatial stress, and typewell-cluster stress. The observed 50/50 diagnostic blend at 15.0131171651 was pre-registered as diagnostic only and cannot be promoted after inspection.
payload.revisit_trigger: A fresh nested or cross-fit fusion experiment passes every frozen repeated-map, p90, worst-tail, spatial, typewell-cluster, control, runtime, and deployment gate.
